sql: WITH l AS (SELECT id, name, status, month, day_preference, day_of_month, guests, unit, origem, created_at FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND name ILIKE '%jonat%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), w AS (SELECT w.id FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN l ON w.lead_id = l.id ORDER BY w.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT 'lead' AS k, NULL::timestamptz AS ts, row_to_json(l)::text AS txt FROM l UNION ALL SELECT 'msg', m.timestamp, (CASE WHEN m.from_me THEN 'EU[' || coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '-') || ']: ' ELSE 'CLIENTE: ' END) || left(coalesce(m.content, m.message_type), 700) FROM wapi_messages m JOIN w ON m.conversation_id = w.id UNION ALL SELECT 'hist', h.created_at, h.action || ' | ' || coalesce(h.user_name, '') || ' | ' || coalesce(h.new_value, '') FROM lead_history h JOIN l ON h.lead_id = l.id ORDER BY 2 NULLS FIRST
